newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Rail basis offers higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Rail basis offers higher.

text.p: Soymeal dealers raised asking prices for rail soymeal by $1.00 to $4.00 per ton in reaction to higher prices for soybeans, dealers said.
"Soybeans are very, very tough to buy right now," said a Midwest broker. "If they (processors) want to keep crushing they are going to have to get more for it (soymeal)."
Soymeal basis offers at Decatur, Ill., rose $3.00 since Wednesday to $15.00 per ton over CBOT July futures. Offers at Danville, Ill., went to $15.00 over July from $12.00 Thursday.
Midwest soybean dealers said some crushers raised bids for soybeans three to five cents per bushel early Friday.
Some dealers said hog and poultry dealers continue to buy the higher-priced soymeal because they can mix it with corn for a cost-effective feed.
